name: Veronika Cifrová Ostrihoňová - Après le § 32 - Am 13
title: REPORT on public access to documents – report covering the years 2022 - 2024
part_text: 32a. Calls for a thorough and independent review of the conduct of the President of the Commission in relation to the preservation and handling of documents requested under Regulation (EC) No 1049/2001; stresses that members of the Commission are bound by the principles of transparency, integrity and good administration laid down in Article 17 TEU and Articles 41 and 42 of the Charter; considers that, where serious breaches of document preservation or transparency obligations are established, appropriate disciplinary or institutional measures must be examined in order to uphold the rule of law, safeguard the credibility of the EU’s legal order and restore public trust;
